SR=Itail/Cc=4 V/us. The 2nd stage uses gm/Id 11-14, so Vdsat is about 0.1-0.15 V and swing is >1.35 V even at 1.62 V. Current is about 72 uA, which is about 140 uW at 1.98 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (large area -> low flicker)
    "ktail": (1.0, 0.8, 2.0),        # Itail = ktail * iref
    "I6":    (50e-6, 30e-6, 90e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid6": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load + CS stage gm/Id
    "L6":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS L (load mirror and M6)
    "gmidT": (14.0, 10.0, 16.0),     # NMOS current sources gm/Id (low vdsat)
    "LT":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS current source L
    "Cc":    (2.5e-12, 1.5e-12, 4e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),        # Rz scale vs zero-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["ktail"] * iref
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    # NMOS current sources (all mirror the ibias diode: same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], itail, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6)
    # PMOS mirror load and CS second stage (same gm/Id, L -> zero systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], i1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (Cc + cl) / (m6.gm * Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting at vout
    n.dev("M1", "xd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x1", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "vout", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "x1", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c2 = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c2 * Cc + c2 * (m6.cgg) + Cc * m6.cgg))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = 1.98 * (iref + itail + I6)
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds)
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 6
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.15
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)) * 2.5  # flicker allowance
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise, "vos": 1e-3}
